services.story: The same house call, paid by Alex himself: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $179 bill when Felipe texts DONE.

services_shape: visits of a set length, booked with an allergist or a nurse practitioner by name; a new patient's first visit is longer and the owner OKs it; skin tests are a visit on the allergist's order; allergy shots are given only at the office, in a visit that holds 30 minutes after the shot, never at home or by video, and are never paid up front; follow-ups are booked by the office at checkout; a house call has a 2-hour arrival window; no same-day sick times: a worry goes to the nurse line first
questions_before_times: a new or a current patient
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
for a video visit: which state the patient will be in
who the visit is for: the person booking, a child, or another adult
safety_stop: trouble breathing, a tight or closing throat, swelling of the lips, tongue or face, hives with dizziness or fainting, vomiting after a bite, sting, food or a shot, or any bad reaction right after an allergy shot
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
first_steps: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
The owner's OK for a new patient
license: the business's own word only: Rosie never requires a license or insurance and never checks one (D96); a clinician's license is for the business to add if it wants it shown; a license the owner says the work needs, and that a person doesn't hold, stops that person's bookings for it
staff_skills: allergists and nurse practitioners: new patients, follow-up visits, skin tests, video follow-ups and house calls; nurses: allergy shots on the allergist's order, in the office; home blood draws: someone the owner has cleared for them; only people cleared for house calls go to homes
messages_never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, symptoms, medicines, test results or the clinician's name (at a house call the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
